name: Crisis Management LLM Benchmark (C1–C16)
description: This repository contains the complete data, materials, and analysis code supporting the study "How Well Can Large Language Models Manage Intraoperative Crisis? A Multicenter Blinded Benchmark on 16 Anaesthesia Scenarios". Contents: (1) scenario_corpus_C1-C16.xlsx — 16 clinical scenarios with prompt context, time-critical first-line action, and reference-standard decision tree. (2) reference_standards.xlsx — guideline-anchored reference decisions, cross-referenced to AHA 2020, ESAIC 2022, ASA difficult-airway 2022, and other current guidelines. (3) expert_ratings_blinded.xlsx — de-identified accuracy ratings from 3 board-certified anaesthetists (double-blinded, randomised order). (4) fixed_prompt_template.txt — the exact prompt fed to every evaluated model. (5) analysis_scripts/ — R / Python scripts that reproduce all tables (Table 1–3) and figures (Fig. 1–3; Supplementary Fig. S1). (6) README.md — column-level data dictionary and reproducibility instructions (random seeds, package versions). Scope of sharing: All identifiers removed. No protected health information. No human-subject IRB was required (simulation-only evaluation). License: CC-BY 4.0. Suggested citation will be added upon manuscript acceptance.
